description: The fixed price and what it includes for a finished check (s-… from start_website_check, or i-… for a described idea): setup excl. VAT paid 30/40/30, monthly or yearly care, and what is priced in the call. By default for the options we recommend from the check; pass options to price another selection. Applications have no fixed price (agreed after the assessment or a call). Nothing is ordered: the person orders on the check's page.

options.description: Optional option keys to price instead of the recommendation, e.g. ["languages","booking"]. The basics are always included.

name: get_check_quote
title: Fixed price for a finished website check
